name: Com2
description: Com2 is a benchmark focusing on complex commonsense reasoning in large language models, incorporating causal event graphs and causal theory to create structured and varied reasoning scenarios. It includes a challenging subset based on detective stories to test reasoning depth and breadth.
reputation: A new research benchmark for complex commonsense reasoning that is not yet broadly established as a standard leaderboard.
notes: Uses causal event graphs and intervention to generate complex commonsense reasoning tasks; includes a detective story subset; code and data publicly available.
